fact_text: The Organic Meat Company exports frozen meat, and its growth has been driven by demand from China and Central Asian countries.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: Export demand covers mature-animal meat, calf meat and offal, and the company's mix of products is built to meet Chinese and Central Asian orders.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company is cited as one of the top three meat exporters from Pakistan, within a sector of a few dozen exporters.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The Organic Meat Company planned a rights issue of 30 million shares, about 3 crore shares, raising a total of about PKR 810 million.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The analyst says the rights money roughly matches the amount shown as short-term loans on the balance sheet, so the raise is mainly a working-capital need.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The analyst considers the meat business model sound over the long term, because global and regional demand for meat is rising and the company needs working capital to grow.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The analyst says the rights issue has an arbitrage element, but the long-term meat business model matters more to his view than that short-term feature.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: Aisha Steel's Q1 FY25 net sales were about PKR 4 billion, against about PKR 10 billion in the same quarter a year earlier, a sharp drop.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The analyst attributes Aisha Steel's sales fall mainly to very low capacity utilisation at its plant.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: Aisha Steel was once a strong competitor to International Steels, but the analyst says industry conditions are now tough for both companies.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The sponsor's equity injection strengthened Aisha Steel's balance sheet, and its long-term loans and past losses are not large, so the analyst sees the worst as past.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)

fact_text: The analyst expects Aisha Steel's business to improve around April 2025, as construction activity in Pakistan is expected to pick up from March 2025.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'In-Depth PSX Stock Analysis: TOMCL Right Shares & Aisha Steel Mill Financial Reports Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-11-19)
